title: Bitcoin Is Not Money: Why Fixed Supply Fails in a Modern Economy: replication package
description: Replication package for the paper forthcoming in Asian Economics Letters. From the quantity identity, a hard-capped monetary base with stable velocity turns output growth at rate g into deflation at rate g; the paper applies this to fast-growing Asian economies where crypto adoption is highest. Includes the data behind Figure 1 (IMF growth projections, Chainalysis adoption ranks), the scripts that produce all three figures and the numbers derived in the text.
